hypothesis: Carrying arm WITHOUT's verified repair findings into arm WITH's planner reduces repair rounds on the same mission.

weakness.description: Run 39112358445 (2026-10-18, registration 1's WITHOUT-1, Mission 5's body): one PLAN repair after three blocking review findings (decisions.tsv REPAIR / BLOCKING_FINDINGS on the plan task); the architect's repair was accepted and the build then passed on its first attempt. Read by JULIUS_DEV and by the Independent Reviewer from the preserved bundle (55 files hashed). Earlier evidence of the same shape: run 34529874100 (2026-09-10, Mission 5), whose artifact has expired, which is disclosed.

adaptation.description: julius-knowledge-carry.v3: the verified repair findings a WITHOUT-k run writes are carried, plan-scoped, into its WITH-k run's architect packet; the design in force is never carried; WITH-k is refused before READY when nothing qualifies.
adaptation.changeRef: julius-knowledge-carry.v3 (Decision C candidate; code pinned in the PREREG addendum): the verified repair findings each WITHOUT-k run writes, carried as carried:<WITHOUT-k>:<findingId>:into:<WITH-k>, WITHOUT run ids run:7ca9e3e35e07cc1a487eed6b, run:ca798f52c7b6d2b7f8bf2149

failureRule: The TS policy is ['repairs'], 0.5, 1, identical on all four arms. The experiment counts only under the validity conditions V1-V6 (V1-R included) of DECISION_C4_REGISTRATION_DESIGN r9 (sha256 38621c1c), which carries r8.7 verbatim, section 4, with the arms dispatched in the order WITHOUT-1, WITHOUT-2, WITH-1, WITH-2 under the stop rule of r9 section S2 (after each WITHOUT arm a failed V1-R or a stopped gate ends dispatch and the undispatched arms are recorded NOT DISPATCHED) and each arm's recorded commit equal to the landed commit recorded outside this digest (section 7); a pair failing any of them makes this registration non-creditable. Row 7 (f) is judged by the frozen R7F model-identity spec, recorded outside this digest beside the other instruments (section 7); a verdict-package condition that spec states outside the checker is read at C's verdict, not before WITH-k, and a record there that contradicts the bundle, or none, makes that pair invalid. learning-evaluate runs once, on the four registered arms only, and counts only with a verdict of RETAIN, REJECT or PROVISIONAL and primary.n = {baseline 2, candidate 2}. Any effect is selection-conditioned (V1 requires a coder catch, a diffed repair and an accepting re-review in every baseline) and is not attributed to the carry by itself (section 6). The adaptation is rejected when the primary metric does not move by at least its minimum effect in the expected direction.
